name: quant-screen-trader
description: Cross-platform quantitative market analysis desktop application

scripts.lint:python: node scripts/python.mjs -m ruff check --config services/quant-engine/pyproject.toml services/quant-engine && node scripts/python.mjs -m ruff format --check --config services/quant-engine/pyproject.toml services/quant-engine
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:python

scripts.test: npm run test:js && npm run test:python
